'''Follow the White Rabbit When Pigs attack!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Follow the White Rabbit]]
* '''Published:''' 1 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-D-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber Ra.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Gammorean Deck... Simple decks like this wont work, will they? (they work in magic)

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Twi-lek adviser gets me Den of thieves and Audiance chamber gets me Ortugg.

I play as many Gammorean Guards as possible, but save X in my hand, where X is the ammount of sites I can get drained at, so I can play them on Den of Thieves and take no force drains.

When the time is right I use Elis Helrot to shuttle to other planets and attack with my rampage of Gammoreans! (and Scum and Villiany and None shall pass are just plain good..)

Everyones gonna rate this deck 1 star... i just know it! DOH!
